intent: Give a table its accessible name as a real <caption>, drawn below the rows.
typical_uses: A one-line title or description of what a table lists

dont_use_when.situation: The column headings of the table
Naming the table's focusable scroll region for keyboard users

invariants.text: The table sets caption-side bottom, so the caption paints below the rows wherever it sits among Table's children; it stays the <table>'s caption in the accessibility tree either way.

anti_patterns.dont: Put the table's title in a heading above Table with nothing linking the two
anti_patterns.do_instead: Use TableCaption, or keep the heading and pass aria-labelledby with the heading's id to Table

good.title: A caption as the table's first child

bad.title: A caption outside the table
bad.why: A <caption> outside a <table> is invalid markup and names nothing; TableCaption belongs inside Table.
